shell.historyDescription: Revisions of this file on the current workspace branch. Renamed paths may have separate history. Restoring changes only your unsaved draft.
shell.historyReplaceConfirm: Replace your unsaved changes with this revision? Nothing will be saved or published.
shell.historyIncompatible: This revision is incompatible with the current content schema.

shell.aboutAcknowledgements: Meet the open-source projects behind Rigel in our {acknowledgements}.
shell.updateInstructions: Ask your developer to update Rigel and rebuild the site.
shell.demoBanner: Public demo — changes stay in memory and reset when you refresh. No files are written.

shell.demoDelete: Remove this entry from your demo session? Refresh restores the original content.

shell.apiKeysStorageError: API keys could not be saved in this browser. Allow browser storage and try again.
shell.highContrastHint: Stronger text and borders in both light and dark themes.

shell.localModeHint: No GitHub account connected. Content saves to local files when you press Save.
shell.stockPhotoApiKeysHint: Manage API keys for stock photo services. Keys save automatically in this browser only.
shell.devModeHint: Shows raw JSON of the current draft + field keys next to labels.
shell.fileCacheHint: Remove downloaded file copies and image previews, not drafts, settings or saved content.

shell.fileCacheCleared: File cache cleared. Files will download again when needed.
shell.fileCacheClearError: Memory cache cleared, but browser storage could not be cleared. Check storage permissions and retry.
shell.eraseAllDataHint: Erase Rigel settings, API keys and unsaved drafts from this browser. Files already saved to your repository are not affected.

shell.waitForSave: Wait for the current save to finish.
shell.publishReviewInactive: Publish review is no longer active. Reconnect and review again.

shell.draftsSynced: Drafts synced. Nothing was published. Close this dialog and review again before publishing.

shell.publishVerificationError: Could not verify publishing. Check GitHub before retrying.
shell.configurationLoadError: Could not load the editor configuration. Rebuild the site and try again.
shell.configurationIncomplete: The editor configuration is incomplete. Rebuild the site and try again.
shell.configurationLoadFailed: Could not load the editor configuration.
shell.waitForGithubVerification: Wait for GitHub access verification before saving.

shell.githubConnectionError: Could not connect GitHub. Try signing in again.
shell.githubAccessError: Could not check GitHub access. Try again.
shell.eraseBrowserDataDescription: This removes Rigel settings, API keys, GitHub login and unsaved drafts from this browser. Saved repository files will not change. The editor will reload.
shell.name: Name
shell.title: Title
shell.settingsStorageError: Settings could not be saved in this browser. Allow browser storage and try again.

shell.titleRequired: Enter a title containing letters or numbers.
shell.slugAlreadyUsed: The slug "{slug}" is already used by another document or page.
shell.newPostDescription: Enter a title to start a draft. Nothing is written until you press Save.
shell.discardNewPostDescription: This discards the new post and its unsaved changes.
shell.deleteRemotePostDescription: This deletes {slug}.json from {branch} and discards any unsaved changes. This cannot be undone in the editor.
shell.deleteLocalPostDescription: This deletes {slug}.json and discards any unsaved changes. This cannot be undone in the editor.
shell.signedOutAnotherTab: Signed out in another tab. Reconnect GitHub to save. Your unsaved edits are still here.
shell.noEditingAccess: You don’t have editing access. Contact the website administrator.
shell.accessConfirmed: Access confirmed. Try opening the editor again.
shell.signInHint: Sign in to edit this website.
shell.legalNotice: By continuing, you agree to the {terms} and acknowledge the {privacy}.
shell.sessionExpired: Your GitHub session expired. Your unsaved edits are still here.
shell.repositoryAccessChanged: Repository access changed. Reconnect GitHub before saving.

shell.discardNewPageDescription: This page has not been saved. Deleting it discards the draft.

shell.welcomeTagline: The best CMS in the whole space.
shell.welcomeHint: Select a page or collection from the sidebar to start editing.
shell.reindexHint: Rebuild document and article metadata without changing source content.
